names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 15 decembrie, «Sfântul Cuvios Pavel», with the rank words left off. The mountain is «muntele Latru» in the life and «din Latro» in the troparion's title; the English form of the place is chosen, not copied.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 15 Δεκεμβρίου, «Όσιος Παύλος ο νέος που ασκήτευε στο Λάτριο όρος», with the rank word, the by-name and the clause naming the mountain left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s third heading for 15. децембар ст. ст., „Преподобни Павле у Латри.“ — with «Преподобни» left off, that being the `venerable` grade §5 maps and `types` keeps. What is left is «Павле у Латри», Paul in Latra, and it is kept WHOLE, with the preposition, because it is what the calendar prints and because the alternative is fatal: `fk.mjs` measures the bare «Павле» at EIGHT other holders — `paul-28-june`, `paul-companion-of-andrew`, `paul-companion-of-lucillian`, `paul-companion-of-quadratus`, `paul-of-jamnia`, `paul-of-ptolemais`, `paul-the-apostle`, `paul-the-confessor` — and this folder would be the ninth. A prepositional phrase inside a stored form has precedent in this corpus’s own Serbian forms, «6000 мученика у Грузији» and «Непозната девојка из богате куће у Александрији». NOTHING IS DECLINED OR NORMALISED: «Латри» is the locative the book itself prints, and the mountain’s nominative «Латра» appears in the body. THE FOLD WAS MEASURED BEFORE THE FORM WAS WRITTEN: `fk.mjs` puts the key `латри павле у` at NO other holder.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 15 decembrie — «Sfântul Cuvios Pavel»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 15ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Όσιος Παύλος ο νέος που ασκήτευε στο Λάτριο όρος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 15 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps, and the entry is the same man: Paul the New of Mount Latros, from Elea near Pergamum, younger brother of Basil, who refused the abbacy of the monastery and built a church of the Holy Trinity lower down the mountain. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. **The two sources disagree about his childhood and the disagreement is left standing.** doxologia has his father Antiochus killed in a war near Chios and his mother Eudocia take the children into Phrygia, to the village of Joannicius the Great, and put both sons into the monastery of Saint Stephen; saint.gr has both parents die early and Paul left an unprotected orphan herding pigs for a living until his elder brother Basil, already an ascetic on Latros, sent a monk to fetch him, the villagers at first refusing to give the orphan up, and Basil entrusting him to the ascetic Peter as an apprentice. saint.gr's year is added to the folder, which held none: «Μερικοί Συναξαριστές αναφέρουν ότι πέθανε σε βαθιά γεράματα το 896 μ.Χ.», with the page head «(; - 896)». The page attributes it to some synaxaristes, so the basis is `traditional`. It names Elea near Pergamum and Mount Latros in western Asia Minor near ancient Miletus; no coordinate is proposed. It prints no hymn. **The same day page also keeps nothing else of Latros, but 13 Δεκεμβρίου keeps «Όσιος Αρσένιος που ασκήτευσε στο Λάτριο όρος», drafted in that day's batch as `arsenios-of-latros`.**

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 28.12.2025 (15. децембар ст. ст.) — „Преподобни Павле у Латри.“

attestations.note: The day’s third entry, quoted whole with its closing full stop; URL year 2025. It is the third calendar to keep him on this menologion day. `types` UNTOUCHED: «Преподобни» is the `venerable` held, and the book gives him no other grade. `dates` WIDENED, and this is the one substantive change: the folder carried a flat 896 off saint.gr, which attributed it to «μερικοί Συναξαριστές», some synaxaristes, rather than stating it; this book states 950 flatly — «У старости упокојио се мирно и преселио ка Господу 950. године». The two years are now the bounds of one interval and neither is preferred. NO `locations`: Pergamum and Mount Latros are two places and the folder has never held a coordinate. NO `related` ROW ADDED: this entry names nobody — not the brother Basil, not the elder Peter, not Joannicius — so the three rows the folder already holds are untouched and no fourth is made. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS beyond the year: nothing but its brevity, four lines where the other two calendars print the childhood, the stones on the rope, the translation and the wonders. Its «Родом од Пергама», from Pergamum by birth, agrees with saint.gr’s Elea near Pergamum and with doxologia’s district of Elea near the city of Pergamum. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

hymns.text: Ca cel ce eşti împreună locuitor cu cei fără de trup şi tuturor cuvioşilor părtaş, Prealăudate Pavel, pe tine te lăudăm şi ne rugăm ţie: roagă-te pentru noi ca întotdeauna să aflăm milă.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Cuvios Pavel din Latro; the page prints the podobie «Pe Cuvântul Cel împreună...» above the text, and hyphenates some words for its own layout

english.text: As one who dwells together with the bodiless powers and shares the lot of all the venerable, most praised Paul, we praise you and pray to you: pray for us, that we may always find mercy.

death.note: **Two books, two years, fifty-four years apart, and the interval is widened to hold both rather than choose.** The folder carried 896 flat: saint.gr’s last line, «Μερικοί Συναξαριστές αναφέρουν ότι πέθανε σε βαθιά γεράματα το 896 μ.Χ.», which attributes the year to some synaxaristes and does not state it as the page’s own, with the page head «(; - 896)». The Охридски пролог за 15. децембар ст. ст. states its year flatly: „У старости упокојио се мирно и преселио ка Господу 950. године.“ — in old age he reposed in peace and passed over to the Lord in the year 950. Both agree he died in deep old age and neither gives a year of birth. Nothing between the bounds is claimed; the basis stays traditional, no document being cited by either book.
